description:
FILED s473t6b (Opus, 2026-09-17) by #1501 round 9.

PERL: `$#a` is a MAGICAL LVALUE on the array, not a number copied out of it.
A reference to it (`\$#a`) carries arylen magic, so:
  * writing through the reference resizes the array;
  * once the ARRAY is gone the reference reads UNDEF (the magic has nothing
    to point at) and reading it WARNS ("Attempt to set length of freed array"
    for a write);
  * a foreach ALIAS to it is the same lvalue: `for (scalar $#a) { $_ = 3 }`
    sets `$#a` to 3.

PCL: the write THROUGH A REFERENCE works (`my $p = \$#b; $$p = 1` resizes),
but the other two do not.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL, probes/p2.pl G2):

    my $r;
    { my @a = (1,2,3); $r = \$#a; }
    printf "freed=%s\n", (defined $$r ? $$r : 'undef');
    my @b = (1,2,3);
    for my $x ($#b) { $x = 0 }
    printf "foreach_alias=%d\n", scalar(@b);

    perl: freed=undef   foreach_alias=1
    PCL:  freed=2       foreach_alias=2

WHAT IT COSTS, row by row (baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv):
  op/array.t  83 `$a: $# on freed array is undef`
              84 `$a: number of warnings`          (the write's warning)
              85 `$a: msg`                         (its text)
              86 `do {}: $# on freed array is undef`
              87 `do {}: number of warnings`
              88 `do {}: msg`
             100 `orphaned $#foo is always undef`
             126 `arylen_p magic does not stop isa magic from being copied`
             172 `assigning to arylen aliased in foreach(scalar $#arylen)`
  op/sort.t  184 `sort block modifying $a and $b`  -- the shape is
             `() = [sort { $a = 10; $b = 10; 0 } $#a, $#a]; is $#a, 10`, i.e.
             the sort's $a/$b ALIAS the arylen lvalue and the block writes
             through them.

SHAPE: PCL's `\$#a` produces a box that holds a COPY of the last index and a
write path back to the array; it needs to be a cell whose reader asks the
array (so a freed array reads undef) and whose writer is the resize.  The
`foreach` half follows for free once the alias is that cell rather than a
fresh box -- the same rule the #127 defelem-lite cells already implement for
ELEMENTS, so the mechanism exists and this is another kind of magical slot,
not a new one.  The two warning rows (84/85, 87/88) are
`NS:Warnings-gated diagnostics are absent` (#221) and will not close with
this task.

NOT ATTEMPTED in s473t6b: the round's budget went to #403 and the die/$@
family; this one needs the arylen cell and its own guard file.
subject: arylen magic: \$#a is a magical LVALUE, so a ref to it reads UNDEF once the array is freed and a foreach ALIAS to it writes through -- PCL copies the index instead (7 op/array.t rows + 1 op/sort.t row)
